description: withdraw() loses its nonReentrant modifier AND moves the balances[msg.sender] -= amount write from before the external call to after it, both in the same commit. Guard removal and CEI break happen together.
why_labeled: This is the 2a/2b arbitration boundary. Both signals are present, but 2a has priority: when a function both loses its guard and breaks CEI in one commit, it is a single 2a finding, not a separate 2b finding (avoids double-counting one regression). Rule 2b MUST stay quiet because the guard situation DID change (present at N-1, absent at N), which is exactly the condition that hands ownership to 2a. also_fires:["2a"] records that 2a firing here is expected.
